description:
You are a wind energy engineer evaluating candidate airfoils for a small wind turbine operating at moderate Reynolds numbers. Three NACA airfoil coordinate files are available in /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/: naca0015.dat (symmetric, 15% thickness), naca2412.dat (2% camber, 12% thickness), and naca4412.dat (4% camber, 12% thickness). Import all three airfoils into QBlade, run XFoil viscous analysis on each at Reynolds number 1,000,000 over an angle of attack range from -5 degrees to 20 degrees, and export each airfoil's polar data to separate files:

- /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/polar_naca0015.txt
- /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/polar_naca2412.txt
- /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/polar_naca4412.txt

Each exported polar file should contain the aerodynamic coefficients (Cl, Cd, etc.) as columns across the analyzed angle of attack range. You are already logged in as user 'ga'.
